label: copy-phase input z or l (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (98% of mass) when the fed-back input token is z or l (about 95% of activations and mass). It is strongest right after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, i.e. the input is the first original token l) and in longer sequences (L 8-9). It never fires on the delimiter step, and fires almost never in the original phase (only on late positions 7-8, on tokens like k, s, i, f). Apart from z/l, a few copy-phase activations land on 2 or w when they are the first token. It fires on only about 1.5% of copy-phase z/l inputs, so some other condition decides which of those steps activate, and I could not find it. Activations are somewhat more likely when the token being output is i, l or 0, or the next output is i, and when v or i appears in the original sequence, but none of these conditions gets precision above about 10%. Magnitude is small (median 0.12, max 0.23).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+5.07), phase=2 & in_tok=l (+4.70), in_tok=2 (+3.27), phase=2 & out_tok=l (+3.16), orig_idx=8 (+3.03), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.81). Lower it: out_tok=v (-3.53), prev_tok=o (-2.40), orig5=- (-1.95), orig4=- (-1.86).
